items.headline: Low Water Advisory issued November 23 at 1:40PM CST until November 24 at 9:00AM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.description:
* WHAT...Abnormally low water levels.

* WHERE...Matagorda Bay.

* WHEN...For the Low Water Advisory, until 9 AM CST Tuesday. For
the Small Craft Advisory, until noon CST today.

* IMPACTS...Below normal water levels will result in hazardous
navigating conditions.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Forecasted low tides will be near or below
1.0 ft below Mean Low Low Water through the next several days.
Small craft should also exercise caution tonight into Tuesday as
moderate to strong northeasterly winds develop.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.

Mariners should navigate shallow waters with extreme caution due
to below normal water levels.
